Features.title: Walk into every interview with a story ready
Features.description: BriefStory turns the experience you already have into answers that are clear, specific, and easy to deliver.

generate.title: Bullets to STAR Stories
generate.description: Paste a resume bullet or project summary and get a structured Situation, Task, Action, Result answer in seconds.

refine.title: Refine with More Context
refine.description: Add details the first draft missed, like numbers, stakeholders, or trade-offs, and get a sharper version of the same story.

teleprompter.title: Rehearse with the Teleprompter
teleprompter.description: Practice out loud with a scrolling teleprompter, so the story sounds natural when the interviewer asks.
